rule: Biological opportunity, fishing regulation, physical access, and private-release readiness are independent gates.

regulation_findings.finding: Lake trout and splake possession season is open all year under the reviewed 2026 guide.

city_access_gates.finding: Both pierheads are covered separately; dawn-to-dusk park approach, parking rules, waves, ice, barricades, and posted closures control.
Both piers are covered separately and may be closed under red-flag/high-wave policy; lower Harborwalk remains separately labeled.
North pier and state-park channel walkway are covered; the south route remains excluded because no public walkway is available.
The entire marina is closed September 8, 2026 through May 28, 2027; biological calibrations remain research-only and cannot imply current access.
Fishing is limited to designated areas and unoccupied docks; current signs, occupancy, off-season policy, and breakwater access require direct confirmation.
